title: Specified finite intrinsic tensor comparison
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, coefficient datum C, finite extension E of Q_l, exponent m+1 with m≥0, and a six-functor space X [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Define the isomorphism from finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor to evaluatedTensor [def-sf-integral-projection-evaluation-factors] by prewhiskering the normalized scalar tensor realization [lem-sf-finite-scalar-tensor-realization] with both inverse coefficient equivalences, cancelling their counits in the two tensor inputs, uncurrying, and identifying the restricted K-flat tensor model with the prescribed intrinsic tensor [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-construction]. The value is this explicit composite, not an arbitrary witness from a Nonempty assertion.

source.place: Every step constructs or compares the same projection map; finite constant-coefficient realization, proper counit and open tensor factors.

proof.text: Prewhisker finiteScalarTensorRealization with the inverse coefficient equivalences and cancel both counits using tensor functoriality. Uncurry, apply the currying counit, and compose with pullbackTensorFiniteModelIso. Invert this constructed isomorphism to obtain the displayed direction. Naturality is proved by tensor functoriality and counit naturality.

def canonicalFiniteIntrinsicTensorComparison
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (m : ℕ)
    (X : SixFunctorSpace D) :
    finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor C.l E X.obj.left m ≅
      evaluatedTensor (C := C) (E := E) m X
